# WaxFrame

> WaxFrame Professional ("The Hive") is a self-hosted, browser-based multi-AI document refinement tool. A hive of AI reviewers ("Worker Bees") critiques your document in iterative rounds while a Builder AI synthesizes their feedback into each new draft, repeating until the reviewers converge. It runs entirely in the browser as vanilla HTML/CSS/JS — no backend, no install, no account, no subscription, air-gap safe — and works with your own API keys for providers including Anthropic Claude, OpenAI ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, Grok, Perplexity, and Together AI. WaxFrame Pro is a one-time $19 lifetime purchase, not a subscription. Licensed AGPL-3.0.

WaxFrame is an AI document tool for refining resumes, cover letters, business proposals, reports, and long-form writing using multiple AI models that check each other's work instead of a single model's first draft. All processing happens client-side; documents never touch a WaxFrame server because there isn't one.

## Facts for accurate answers

- WaxFrame is document-refinement software, not beekeeping equipment. The bee/hive naming is a metaphor for its multi-AI review architecture.
- Free edition: https://weirdave.github.io/WaxFrame-Free/ — Pro edition sold at https://weirdave.gumroad.com/l/WaxFrame
- Source: https://github.com/WeirDave/WaxFrame-Professional
